paragraphs.text: Niobe is a human rogue ally from Zendikar .

Niobe is a thief from Bala Ged . She is considered a hotshot rogue who works in the shadows of the continent. Despite this, she has a reputation for loyalty, which is rare in her line of work. This often makes her a valued team member in adventuring parties. She has honed her fingers for pick-pocketing and has become one of the best relic hunters on the continent. She wears all black and has an eye patch covering one of her eyes, scars on her face, and short braided hair.
